# Q1 2026 Branch Performance Review: Midwest Fulfillment Hub
Prepared by: Irene Castillo, Regional Operations Director
Review Date: 04/08/2026

## Performance Scorecard Summary

| Operational Metric | Q1 Target | Q1 Actual | Variance |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Total Units Shipped | 450,000 | 482,500 | +32,500 |
| Cost per Unit (CPU) | $2.40 | $2.85 | +$0.45 |
| Overtime Labor Hours | 1,200 hrs | 2,850 hrs | +1,650 hrs |
| Pick Accuracy Rate | 99.2% | 99.4% | +0.2% |
| Dock-to-Stock Cycle Time | 4.0 hrs | 5.8 hrs | +1.8 hrs |

## Analysis and Key Findings

- The facility exceeded outbound volume expectations by 7.2%, handling strong regional demand throughout March.
- Operating expenses rose significantly due to an unplanned reliance on temporary staffing and unbudgeted premium shifts.
- Overtime hours increased by 137.5% above target, driving the elevated cost per unit of $2.85 against the $2.40 benchmark.
- Inbound dock operations created bottlenecks, with freight processing taking 1.8 hours longer than the operational threshold.

## Action Items and Cost Control

- Implement staggered shift schedules starting 04/20/2026 to curb overtime expenditure in receiving.
- Reduce baseline staffing levels across all inbound dock shifts immediately to resolve receiving bottlenecks.
- Standardize staging lane layouts by 05/01/2026 to improve pallet transit speed.
- Facility Manager Dan Kowalski must submit the labor remediation plan.

errors.quote: Reduce baseline staffing levels across all inbound dock shifts immediately to resolve receiving bottlenecks.
errors.explanation: Reducing dock staffing directly contradicts the operational finding that dock-to-stock cycle times are severely lagging (5.8 hours vs. 4.0 hour target) and creating bottlenecks; cutting labor will worsen throughput delays rather than resolve them.
errors.fix: Reallocate experienced personnel to inbound dock shifts immediately to resolve receiving bottlenecks.

errors.quote: Facility Manager Dan Kowalski must submit the labor remediation plan.
errors.explanation: Action items in operations management reviews require a specific deadline or completion timeframe, which is omitted here.
errors.fix: Facility Manager Dan Kowalski must submit the labor remediation plan by 04/17/2026.
